title: Targeted Fee Integrity Cleanup — Post Batch 10 (Singapore EntrePass & Hong Kong IANG)
scopeConstraint: Strictly limited to correcting and separating fee information for p2-sg-entrepass and p2-hk-iang. Zero new pathways implemented. Zero changes to Batches 0-9 or the other 8 Batch 10 pathways. Zero production DB/SQLite/Neon/cron modifications.

modifiedClaims.summary: Isolated SGD 105 upfront initial application submission fee per pass from issuance/conditional charges, switched primary evidence URL from /key-facts to /apply-for-a-pass (updated 2026-07-07), noted renewal /renew-a-pass omission of SGD 105, and accurately recorded family-pass rejection forfeiture without inventing a principal refund clause.

Reassigned CLM-SG-B10-S18-2 to the mandatory SGD 225 pass issuance/renewal fee upon approval, citing MOM /apply-for-a-pass & /renew-a-pass (updated 2026-01-01) and SGD 65.40 incl. GST unneeded card replacement.

Reclassified conditional SGD 30 Multiple Journey Visa (MJV) fee from GLOBAL to NATIONALITY_SPECIFIC linked to ICA Visa Requirements (updated 2026-10-28); never rolled into a universal mandatory total.

changesByPathway.publicDisplayFix: Updated src/data/singaporeVisas.ts EntrePass entries (in-to-sg-work-009, in-to-sg-biz-004, in-to-sg-leg-002) from truncated 'SGD 105' to separated 'SGD 105 (Application) + SGD 225 (Issuance); + SGD 30 MJV only if visa-requiring passport (Renewal: SGD 225 issuance)' with direct MOM /apply-for-a-pass URL.

modifiedClaims.summary: Replaced incorrect '2026 two-tier' phrasing with statutory commencement '26 February 2025 at 11:00 a.m.' under Cap. 115A Schedule 2 reg. 11(6), clarifying mandatory upfront non-refundable HKD 600 application fee per principal and each dependant on every initial entry & extension (not full cost).

Reclassified two-tiered approval issuance fee from GLOBAL to RESIDENCE_SPECIFIC indexed to permitted stay duration band (>180 days / 6+ mos = HKD 1,300; <=180 days = HKD 600) under Cap. 115A Schedule 2 Items 1(a) & 6(a), showing HKD 1,900 vs HKD 1,200 combined examples per person.

Verified extension/change-of-stay fees (HKD 600 non-refundable application + HKD 1,300 >180d or HKD 600 <=180d issuance), GovHK/ImmD App e-Visa payment methods, and mandatory physical presence in Hong Kong at payment & collection per IANG.html (updated 2026-04-29); recorded HTTP 404 on /eng/services/fees/visas.html.

changesByPathway.publicDisplayFix: Updated audit and renderer components to display separated application, approval/issuance (>180d vs <=180d), refundability, effective dates, and Last Verified: 2026-11-13 without exposing internal reviewer notes.
